assimilated_principles: scientific claim and evidence role before plot selection
rejected_patterns: copy and manually edit one plotting script per project
embed a pre-rendered example image as a native run
treat arbitrary effect-strength thresholds as rendering success
adjust simulated data until a visual signal passes
infer scientific column roles from semantic similarity
claim journal specifications without a current official guide

source_execution_findings.self_report_limitation: The source evaluation checks one selected script syntax and preview existence per figure type; it does not execute and reload every plot implementation.
